content:
The artist, in a moment of quiet contemplation. | Photo by Elizabeth Lopatto / The Verge	

The pianist sits before her instrument. She carefully extends a front paw, pressing gingerly on a key. She presses again, and again. She is composing some soul music, because something terrible has happened to her: The vacuum cleaner has come out of the closet.

title: The Audi S6 Sportback E-tron proves that sedans still matter

The car demonstrates that sedans remain relevant despite the industry's shift toward SUVs.
content:
Last year, Audi announced that it gave its all-EV-by-2033 plan the boot, and instead will offer a mix of gasoline, hybrid, and electrified propulsion. Even so, what it's currently offering on the EV front is rather good, and fits into the German brand's under-the-radar fast sedan tradition quite well.

title: LG’s new OLED breakthrough can boost display lifespans
summary: LG Display unveiled FLiPP, a new OLED manufacturing process that eliminates fine metal masks to produce brighter, longer-lasting, and more efficient panels. The breakthrough could transform OLED production and enable flexible displays of nearly any size.
content:
LG Display unveiled the new FLiPP panel process at IMID 2026 on August 19th. | Image: LG Display	

LG Display has unveiled a new OLED manufacturing method that reportedly results in panels that are brighter, longer-lasting, more efficient, and theoretically can be almost any size. This new technology is called FLiPP (FMM-Less innovative Pixel Patterning), which LG Display describes as a "dream next-generation OLED" patterning method that aims to eliminate some of the existing limitations in OLED panels.
